event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review your sumatriptan refill request in this thread today, since acute migraine medicine works best taken early and you report being out of sumatriptan. This matches your usual migraine pattern, so messaging review is reasonable. If that review can't be obtained today, contact a same-day pharmacy or clinic option. Call 911 for sudden weakness, numbness, speech trouble, or a sudden worst-ever headache.
